THE ECHO BELOW · SCENE
Area 4 · Steep passage
Change prepared scene
Say aloud

The main passage climbs steeply beside the stream. Spray darkens the stone, and loose rubble shifts underfoot. Above the noise, you can make out another passage crossing high overhead.

Water follows the slope past your boots, leaving the rising stone slick and dark. The crossing overhead is separate from the route at your feet; from here, you can judge the climb and look for movement above without knowing where either passage ends.

Ask the players

“Do you take the stream passage, test the rubble, or look for another route?”
